# sdfkjh.com

> sdfkjh is six letters off the home row of a keyboard (sdf + kjh). The site is a single-page craft showcase: every section is a working artifact built by hand (a live Markdown renderer, a format switcher, an in-page design-token editor, an effects lab, and a JavaScript REPL), not a description of one. Brand work decides how a thing sounds and looks; web work decides whether it loads, ranks, and lasts. The page is the portfolio.

Full page content for language models: https://sdfkjh.com/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Home](https://sdfkjh.com/): the showcase itself. Interactive REPL, per-section design editor, effects lab, self-hosted fonts and imagery, no third-party trackers.
- [Design range](https://sdfkjh.com/range): one markup rendered in seventeen complete design systems. Switch the whole look live, then tune color, type, and layout in the browser.
- [Privacy](https://sdfkjh.com/privacy): what the site does and does not collect (no analytics, no tracking cookies).
- [Do Not Sell or Share](https://sdfkjh.com/do-not-sell): voluntary CCPA/CPRA stance.
- [Terms](https://sdfkjh.com/terms): terms of use.
- [Accessibility](https://sdfkjh.com/accessibility): accessibility statement and WCAG 2.2 AA commitment.
- [Compliance](https://sdfkjh.com/compliance): the legal and accessibility layer every page carries.

## The studies

Standalone design-technique pages: each proves one device from the printed tradition, live and measured. Noindex by choice; linked only from the home page.

- [Axial grid](https://sdfkjh.com/axial): one spine, the wordmark exploded into five materials.
- [Swiss grid](https://sdfkjh.com/swiss): the International Typographic Style, the grid made visible.
- [Editorial spread](https://sdfkjh.com/spread): a magazine opening set live: drop cap, measured columns, footnotes.
- [Type specimen](https://sdfkjh.com/type): the site's own five-file font stack inspected, with the bill in bytes.
- [Raw document](https://sdfkjh.com/brutalist): web brutalism, the HTML undisguised; a component you can strip to its raw browser default, with its real source printed live.

## The console

The homepage includes a working JavaScript REPL: `whoami` · `brand` · `web` · `both` · `time` · `weather [city]` (wttr.in) · `news` (Hacker News) · `cve` (NVD/NIST) · `ping <host>` · `clear`. The weather, news, and CVE commands are the only outbound calls the page ever makes, and only when a visitor types them.

## Site family

sdfkjh.com is the parent of a small family of hand-built sites. Machine-readable directory: https://sdfkjh.com/api/sites

- [BYOB](https://byob.sdfkjh.com/): Be Your Own Broker. Car buying without the dealership F&I middleman, keeping the deal in the buyer's hands.
- [Tank Talks](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/): freshwater aquarium keeping, explained plainly. How-to and troubleshooting on fish, shrimp, plants, and water chemistry.
- [Business Internet Quotes](https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/): finds business-grade internet providers serviceable at a specific commercial address. Free to the business; carriers pay the referral.

## Agent access

- MCP server (read-only, no auth, Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.sdfkjh.com/mcp with tools get_overview, list_sites, list_repl_commands. Server card: https://sdfkjh.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Markdown content negotiation: request any content page with `Accept: text/markdown` for a clean markdown version.
- API catalog: https://sdfkjh.com/.well-known/api-catalog (the site directory at GET /api/sites).
- Agent skills: https://sdfkjh.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Crawl policy: AI crawlers are welcome for search and real-time answering; content is not licensed for training. See https://sdfkjh.com/robots.txt

## Facts

- Static site, hand-built, no framework. Vanilla JS, edge-served on Cloudflare Pages.
- Fonts and images are self-hosted; the page loads no third-party resources on page load.
- No analytics, no tracking cookies.
- One page renders in five formats: html · markdown · json · css · javascript.
- Type: Newsreader, Source Serif 4, JetBrains Mono. Palette: paper, ink, amber.
